versions.changelog: Library-wide disclaimer: guidance, not professional advice
Description tail link + agents machine-readable metadata line (deciqai.com/s/travel-repeat-client-ladder.json)

- Initial release of the **travel-repeat-client-ladder** skill for travel advisors.
- Focuses on transforming one-time bookers into long-term, recurring clients.
- Provides domain-specific rungs for the customer-relationship-ladder—first trip, profiled client, annual, and advocate—each with actionable triggers.
- Includes best practices, worked examples, verification checklist, and red flags for effective client nurture.
- Designed for both solo advisors (simple profile, annual touch) and agencies (VIP loyalty tiers).
- Do not use for purely transactional, one-off bookings with no repeat intent.
